summary.text: Your limit depends on your age and CPF savings. Check it in the Top-ups section of your Retirement Dashboard.

details.heading: Check your top-up limit
details.body: You can check your maximum amount in the “Top-ups” section of your Retirement Dashboard.

details.heading: If you are below 55
details.body: Your limit is the amount needed to reach the Current Full Retirement Sum, after your SA savings and certain SA withdrawals are counted.

details.heading: If you are 55 or above
details.body: Your limit is the amount needed to reach the Current Enhanced Retirement Sum, after your RA savings and CPF LIFE premium amounts are counted.

example_phrasings: What is the maximum amount of top-ups I can receive?
How much can I top up?

sources.page_title: What is the maximum amount of top-ups I can receive?

quotes.text: The maximum amount of top-ups you can receive depends on your age and your CPF savings.
You can easily check your top-up limit in the “Top-ups” section of your Retirement Dashboard.
If you are below 55, you can refer to the “Maximum amount you can top up using cash” to reach the Current Full Retirement Sum.
If you are 55 or above, you can refer to the “Maximum amount you can top up using cash” to reach the Current Enhanced Retirement Sum.
